* Cohorts 1 to 4, Cohorts 7 to 10, Cohort EGFR, and Cohort ALK/RET: 24 months.

* Cohort 6: 4 cycles of neo-adjuvant treatment and 18 cycles of adjuvant treatment, i.e., 12 months of adjuvant treatment.`
